notes.content: Orbit's API is built with FastAPI and runs on Python 3.12.
Orbit stores data in Postgres 15, accessed through SQLAlchemy 2.
Orbit's background jobs run on Celery with a Redis broker.
Decision on 2026-02-03: use Alembic for Orbit database migrations because it integrates with SQLAlchemy.
Bug on 2026-02-20: Orbit's /orders endpoint returned duplicate rows because the join on order_items was missing DISTINCT; fixed by adding a unique constraint on (order_id, sku).
Orbit's primary branch is master.
Convention: Orbit code is formatted with ruff format and linted with ruff check; line length is 100.
Orbit tests run with uv run pytest; integration tests must use a real Postgres container, not mocks.

On 2026-03-18 the Orbit integration test suite passed while production migrations were failing, because mocked database tests hid the broken migration; this is why Orbit integration tests must hit a real Postgres.
Orbit's CI runs on GitHub Actions and takes about 8 minutes.
Gotcha: Orbit's Redis cache keys must include the tenant id, otherwise tenants see each other's data.
Orbit deploys to Fly.io using the script ops/deploy.sh and requires FLY_API_TOKEN to be set.
On 2026-05-20 the team decided to move Orbit from Celery to Arq for background jobs because Celery's memory usage was too high.
Alice prefers small pull requests under 300 lines for Orbit.
Bob owns the Orbit billing module and must review every change under billing/.
The Orbit billing module integrates with Stripe; webhooks are verified using the STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET environment variable.
Gotcha: Stripe webhook retries can deliver the same event twice, so Orbit billing handlers must be idempotent by event id.
Orbit's rate limit is 100 requests per minute per API key, enforced in the gateway.
On 2026-08-18 the rate limit for Orbit was raised from 100 to 300 requests per minute per API key after customer complaints.
Orbit logs are JSON formatted and shipped to Grafana Loki.
Orbit's staging database is reset every Sunday at 03:00 UTC.
Decision on 2026-09-20: Orbit adopts OpenTelemetry for tracing because it is vendor neutral.
Orbit's primary branch was renamed from master to main on 2026-09-28.
The team lunch happens on Thursdays at the office.
Alice is the tech lead of Orbit.
